method: Latest GitHub main verified through gh; reused title inventory of 60 archives/59 distinct source URLs, current own README and all ten primary-doc heading structures read. Not a semantic reread of all competitor articles.
measurement_scope: Editorial candidate queries based on observed titles and task gaps. Search volume, rankings, traffic and conversion are not verified. Secondary candidates are meaningfully distinct questions, not multiplied spelling variants.

gaps.finding: Current titles favor broad explanatory phrasing; explicit card-decline, ticket, paid-but-Free and provider-decision entries are sparse.
gaps.fix: Use plain query-matching task titles plus first-screen answer and next-step links.

gaps.finding: Current docs04 explains materials, but separate ticket progress, evidence timeline and acceptance conditions are not a complete reader path.
gaps.fix: Add safe evidence template, stage/action table and original-order route.

gaps.finding: A price observation table is not enough to choose between different deliverables, account rights, eligibility and support.
gaps.fix: Normalize deliverable/cycle/currency/tax/conditions and mark unknowns; preserve operator disclosure.

gaps.finding: 47 and49 overlap the same platform-choice intent.
gaps.fix: One primary editorial owner and one substantive comparison article, no duplicate recommendation list.

gaps.finding: Recent ten and full list are available, but query-based paths and topic map are not deep enough.
gaps.fix: Keep task navigation and add linked topical index; archives are copies, not counted as new pieces.

gaps.finding: Competitor article count and stars do not establish superior traffic or results.
gaps.fix: Improve sources, actual task utility and attributable clicks/orders; do not promise ranking effects.

scope_detail: All 60 archive titles and ten own primary-doc heading structures compared; own docs03–06 and six representative competitor articles read in full this subtask. Prior inspection of README/sync/price architecture reused. No claim of fresh semantic reading all sixty.

selected_sample_findings.observation: Competitor old virtual-card article answers the search question immediately, lists three concrete frictions, and routes to a specific buyer page.
selected_sample_findings.takeaway: Use the direct opening and branch table; do not copy unmeasured80%/BIN blacklist/20s fulfillment assertions.

selected_sample_findings.observation: Competitor comparison article normalizes Plus/5X/20X columns and repeatedly links price/support; its comparative assertions are not independently verified in this task.
selected_sample_findings.takeaway: Keep reader-friendly comparison but normalize deliverable, validity, tax, currency, account conditions, observation time and unknowns; disclose operator identity.

selected_sample_findings.observation: Competitor refund article offers a concrete state/action table and evidence path.
selected_sample_findings.takeaway: Create post-purchase state guidance and a reusable safe ticket template, without universal refund rules/timelines/success percentages.

selected_sample_findings.observation: Competitor current10-13 guide is substantially more source-backed and qualified than its older virtual-card/shared-account copy.
selected_sample_findings.takeaway: Learn the latest source-backed structure rather than treating every historical archive claim as a current best practice.
